sources.fullCitation: Printed aerial view of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer lot at Culver City, captioned "Airplane view of lot number one, Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer". No photographer, publisher or date appears on the print, and its provenance is unrecorded. Accessed 6 August 2026.

media.altText: Aerial photograph of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer studio lot at Culver City, captioned as an airplane view of lot number one.
media.publicCaption: The Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer lot at Culver City seen from the air, captioned on the print itself as "Airplane view of lot number one, Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer". Kaper joined the studio in 1935.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; printed studio view of the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer lot, Culver City.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The print carries its own caption but names no photographer, publisher or date, and no provenance is recorded for the copy, so no term can be computed and no public-domain claim is made. A reduced-resolution reproduction (1200 × 773 px, from 3048 × 1964 px) stands as documentary context for the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer years.
media.title: Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Studios, Culver City — airplane view of lot number one

places.publicNote: Historic MGM studio complex in Culver City associated with Kaper's MGM career and Hollywood film work. The marker represents the studio site as a whole; the surviving evidence does not identify a particular stage, office or entrance for the linked events.
